core_obligations: Reduction and full faithfulness (proof lines 7302-7332): the statement is proven for sheaves of sets; h_{-1} is the augmentation morphism a_X, so (h_{-1})^{-1} is fully faithful with quasi-inverse h_{-1,*} by the comparison lemma, and the same holds componentwise; the functor-description lemma lifts this to h^{-1} fully faithful with quasi-inverse h_*; U is a hypercovering in (Spaces/S)_fppf; the simple-descent lemma gives a_{fppf}^{-1} fully faithful with essential image the cartesian sheaves on the big total site; a formal chase through the comparison diagram transfers full faithfulness to a^{-1} (see notes).

Essential image (lines 7334-7350): for a cartesian sheaf G on U_etale, h^{-1}G is cartesian on the big fppf total site, hence h^{-1}G = a_{fppf}^{-1}H; the degree-zero part gives h_0^{-1}G_0 = (a_{0,big,fppf})^{-1}H with h_0 = a_{U_0} flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective; the fppf-etale sheaf descent lemma produces F on X_etale with H = (h_{-1})^{-1}F; then h^{-1}G = h^{-1}a^{-1}F and full faithfulness of h^{-1} yields a^{-1}F is isomorphic to G.

The quasi-inverse (lines 7352-7359): fixing theta : a^{-1}F -> G, full faithfulness of a^{-1} gives id is isomorphic to a_*a^{-1} (Categories lemma), hence F is isomorphic to a_*a^{-1}F, and a_*theta combines these into an isomorphism F -> a_*G; pulling back along a and precomposing with theta^{-1} produces the desired isomorphism G is isomorphic to a^{-1}a_*G.
proof_roadmap: Transfer full faithfulness from the big fppf site to the small etale site through the comparison diagram.
Produce the preimage sheaf F via fppf descent along the flat surjective a_{U_0} and conclude a^{-1}F = G.
Build the quasi-inverse isomorphism G = a^{-1}a_*G from the adjoint of a fully faithful functor.
difficulty_reason: Descent theorem (statement 7286-7300, proof 7302-7359): the fppf twin of the chapter's ph descent theorem - full faithfulness transfers through the comparison diagram, and the essential image is obtained via the fppf-etale sheaf descent lemma along the flat surjective degree-zero map instead of an equalizer computation; the quasi-inverse half is a complete adjoint argument; the only formal-chase step is recorded in the notes. H2: formal descent bookkeeping over established descent lemmas.
